rec.name: FAQ Accordion Section
rec.status: Built — design reviewed (desktop and mobile), integration instructions still open

what.text: A FAQ section built as an expandable accordion list of questions and answers. It has been reviewed on desktop and mobile. The first question is expanded by default and the rest are collapsed. The ticket has no description, no settings list and no screenshots. The only durable specs are the layout (accordion) and the first-item-open behavior.

why.text: Answering common objections (shipping, returns, sizing, usage) at the point of decision reduces uncertainty and support-driven drop-off. Opening the first question by default shows visitors that the items are interactive, which invites them to open more. This second point was stated by the builder. The objection-handling rationale is general CRO knowledge, not stated in the ticket.

how.text: Add the FAQ as a theme section. Render each question and answer as an accordion item, with the first item open on load and the others collapsed. Use the same behavior on desktop and mobile. The reviewer asked how to integrate the sections into an existing theme, and no answer is recorded in the ticket, so installation steps still need to be documented. Everything beyond the default-open behavior is inferred.

items: Repeatable FAQ items (question and answer text)
First item open by default (confirmed behavior; unclear whether it is configurable)
Likely: color scheme, spacing and layout width (not confirmed)

dependencies.text: Not documented in the ticket. Assumes a theme that supports sections (Online Store 2.0). The reviewer's open question about how to integrate the sections into a theme suggests the section is delivered as standalone code or files. No metafields or apps are mentioned.

items: Accordion interaction rate (FAQ item opens per session)
Conversion rate on pages with the FAQ
Support ticket volume for FAQ topics
Scroll depth to the FAQ section
